title: Chat-history erase markers accumulate one per erase; no pruning yet
evidence: Owner: UI. packages/health-core/src/chat-session.ts eraseAll (:311) adds one content-free tombstone with an erase: id to chat-history.json per erase (US-11 AC2h); a few bytes each. mergeWithinCap (:112) counts only live conversations, so markers never count toward the 50 cap, and nothing removes them. A pruning rule must keep every marker a page could still be asking under.
